method.eval: exact = a fresh eval on every session of the half (that half's sessions, no reset, up to 60 sessions); sizing picked on H1 by p15 - f15 + 0.5 (p60 - f60); 'fast' = the H1 best p10 - f10. Monthly plan: price x months run.
method.news: funded only: flat from 2 min before to 2 min after each Tier-1 release (CPI, NFP, FOMC 14:00 + 14:30, FOMC minutes = decision + 21 days); a trade open then is closed at the open of the release-2 min 1m bar (5m bar on 2021-25) with 1 tick slippage; an entry inside the window is skipped. worst_case_0830 = every trade open at 08:30 skipped.
method.funded: 1,500 paths x 126 sessions (5-session blocks); funded_qty grid picked on H1 (400 paths) by ($ paid - P(lost) x cost per funded) / 6.
method.life: 6 months from the purchase: eval -> funded; fail / lost -> new eval next session; net = payouts - fees.
method.stack: the accounts on the SAME 1,500 paths (same trades). same_day = bought together (identical copies); week_apart = account j bought 5j sessions later. The Builder 50K uses its lit-funded-firms.md settings.
